scripts.build: node scripts/clean-package.mjs && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir pkg/browser --out-name vidyut --scope siva-sh && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --release --out-dir pkg/node --out-name vidyut --scope siva-sh && node scripts/prepare-npm-package.mjs
scripts.test:types: npm exec --yes --package=typescript -- tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext tests/typecheck.ts
scripts.pack: npm run build && (cd pkg && npm pack)
scripts.publish:npm: npm run build && (cd pkg && npm publish --access public)
